description: See the full cost of a loan: enter amount, interest rate and tenure to get the monthly EMI, total interest, total payable and a year-by-year amortization table.

faqs.a: For each year it shows how much of your payments went to principal vs interest, and the remaining loan balance at year end.
faqs.q: What does the amortization table show?

faqs.a: Interest is charged on the outstanding balance, which is largest at the start, so early payments are mostly interest.
faqs.q: Why is interest higher in the early years?

faqs.a: Yes. It assumes a fixed annual interest rate with monthly compounding over the whole tenure.

howto: Enter the annual interest rate percentage.
Enter the tenure and choose years or months.
View your EMI summary and the yearly amortization table below.
title: Loan Calculator
